question.text: Under Section 20 of the Depositories Act, what is the maximum imprisonment term for contravention of the Act?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 20 of the Depositories Act, any person who contravenes, attempts to contravene, or abets the contravention of the Act, or fails to pay any penalty imposed by the adjudicating officer, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend up to 10 years, or with fine up to Rs 25 crores, or with both. The Trap: 3, 5, and 7 years are common imprisonment ceilings in other regulatory statutes and are easy to confuse with Section 20, which permits imprisonment up to 10 years. Note: Section 20 expressly allows imprisonment, fine up to Rs 25 crores, or both, and operates without prejudice to penalties imposed under other provisions of the Act.
